Patrick... Yeah, I knew Patrick. The kid died in his sleep one day, and Doc - Pasquale - couldn't figure out what signed his death sentence. Patrick's brother threw a tantrum, demanded that Doc perform the autopsy again. So he did.<end>

Nothin'. Still couldn't figure it out. Now, Doc's far too busy saving people's lives to be spendin' too much time on the dead, ya dig. There's so much stuff medicine as a science hasn't even scratched yet, so I can see why sometimes you gotta pull the line. Sad, but we can't have *all* the answers. It wasn't a contagious disease or some other devil, and that's the most important thing.<end>
